name: Subzero Muscle Freeze I THC Roll-On | 2000mg
description:
Chill Medicated SubZero Roll-On
Dosage: 1000mg CBD : 1000mg THC
Activation Time: 15 - 30 minutes
3.0 FL OZ
Freeze out tension. Feel the chill.
Experience deep, targeted relief with SubZero Roll-On, a high-potency blend of 1000mg THC and 1000mg CBD—infused with a therapeutic essential oil blend and an icy burst of menthol and camphor. Whether you’re dealing with sore muscles, tension, or post-workout aches, SubZero delivers fast, localized comfort exactly where you need it.
Crafted for maximum absorption, this easy-to-apply roll-on is mess-free, non-greasy, and formulated to penetrate deeply—without any psychoactive effects.
Ingredients; Water, Propylene Glycol, Menthol Crystals, Aloe Vera Gel, Camphor Essential Oil, CBD Isolate, THC Distillate, Dimethyl Isosorbide, Preservative (Phenoxyethanol, Caprylyl Glycol, Sorbic Acid), Carbomer 940, Frankincense Essential Oil, Lavender Essential Oil, Helichrysum Essential Oil, Myrrh Essential Oil, Triethanolamine
